close_reason: Added Eq to DeviationRunResult's derives. All contained types are already Eq.
description:
Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx.

`pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:649-651`:
```rust
#[non_exhaustive]
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct DeviationRunResult {
    pub findings: Vec<crate::Finding>,
    pub deviated: Vec<DeviatedFinding>,
}
```

Both `Finding` (`pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:514`: `#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]`)
and `DeviatedFinding` (`pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs`: `#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]`)
derive `Eq`. There is no field that is `PartialEq` but not `Eq`, so `Eq` is
trivially derivable.

Idiomatic Rust: when every field implements `Eq`, the containing struct should
also derive `Eq`. The Rust API guidelines (C-COMMON-TRAITS) name `Eq` as part
of the standard set when `PartialEq` is present and total equality holds.

Fix: add `Eq` to the derive: `#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]`.

This is part of the broader pattern flagged in PKIX-qwzx.15 (workspace-wide
inconsistent derives on public types).
title: (IDIOM) P3: DeviationRunResult derives PartialEq but not Eq; both contained types are Eq
